title: 阿波罗限制私人信贷基金赎回 17%市场参与者要求退出
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Investors are again seeking exits from private credit funds this week to new waves of redemption requests 11.6% from a fund at Morgan Stanley and 16.8 requests from Apollo's
segments.zh: 市场参与者本周再次寻求退出私募信贷基金，摩根士丹利一只基金赎回请求达11.6%，阿波罗的零售信贷基金赎回请求达16.8%。

segments.en: largest non-traded BDC, a credit fund for retail investors, both those firms as they promised to do in the documents capped exits at 5%. Olivia Fishlow has been tirelessly covering
segments.zh: 阿波罗最大的非交易型BDC（面向散户的信贷基金）按承诺将退出上限设为5%。Olivia Fishlow一直在追踪这些私募信贷故事，现在她加入我们。

segments.en: all the private credit stories and she joins us now. Olivia, it's just a continuation, should it be surprising that we're still getting in excess of the redemption caps requests to exit
segments.zh: Olivia，这只是一个延续，我们仍然收到超过赎回上限的退出请求，这应该令人惊讶吗？

segments.en: these funds? I don't think it's too surprising it is what we've expected that this quarter the next time of redemption that they would pick up again, but I think what we're seeing
segments.zh: 我不觉得太惊讶，这是我们预期的，本季度下一次赎回窗口会再次增加。但我觉得我们看到的是市场参与者基础的变化。

segments.en: is the change of the investor base. We're hearing that more US investors are less US investors are asking to redeem and it's coming for more offshore investors which I think has been
segments.zh: 我们听说更多美国市场参与者要求赎回，而更多离岸市场参与者也在提出请求，这很有意思。

segments.en: interesting for this time around. Is that a good thing for these funds or a bad thing?
segments.zh: 这对这些基金来说是好事还是坏事？更多不同类型的市场参与者在这样做？

segments.en: Like more different types of investors are doing this? I think it's too early to say I think we'll probably have to wait again until next quarter to see if it's like trend continues, but I think
segments.zh: 现在说还为时过早，可能得等到下个季度看趋势是否持续。但这确实表明，即使我们没看到，市场参与者的观点每个月都在变化。

segments.en: it does say that every month even when things aren't reported the views of investors are changing even if we aren't seeing it ourselves. By the way is there an expectation that this like slows down
segments.zh: 顺便问一下，有没有预期这种赎回潮会很快放缓，还是我们接近尾声了？

segments.en: sometimes soon or are we kind of nearing like the end of this rush to the exits? I think it will now start to change fund to fund because we are seeing as requests move up and more investors
segments.zh: 我认为现在会因基金而异，因为随着请求增加，更多市场参与者被限制赎回，他们会在下个季度赎回，所以还需要一些时间才会放缓。

segments.en: are gated they'll redeem next quarter so I think we still have some time before it slows down.
segments.zh: 我认为现在会因基金而异，因为随着请求增加，更多市场参与者被限制赎回，他们会在下个季度赎回，所以还需要一些时间才会放缓。
